source: The company announced a significant increase in quarterly profits.
reference: The firm reported a large rise in its profits for the quarter.

source: She quickly finished her homework before dinner.
reference: She completed her assignment fast ahead of the evening meal.

source: The scientist carefully examined the strange samples.
reference: The researcher closely inspected the unusual specimens.

source: Because the road was closed we took a different route.
reference: We chose another route since the road was shut.

source: The students were happy with the results of the exam.
reference: The pupils were pleased with how they did on the test.

source: He bought a new car after saving money for several years.
reference: He purchased a new vehicle once he had saved up for years.

source: The teacher explained the difficult concept to the class.
reference: The instructor clarified the hard idea for the students.

source: Heavy rain caused serious problems in the city yesterday.
reference: Yesterday's downpour led to major trouble across the city.

source: The movie was long but the story was really interesting.
reference: The film ran long yet its plot was very engaging.

source: Many people use their phones to read the news every morning.
reference: Lots of individuals read the news on their mobiles each morning.

source: The government plans to build a new hospital in the region.
reference: Authorities intend to construct a new medical centre in the area.

source: It was a beautiful day so we walked to the park.
reference: We went to the park on foot since the day was lovely.
